def can_update(request, session):
    expected = session.get("csrf")
    supplied = request.get("csrf")
    return (request["method"] == "POST" and session.get("user") is not None
            and isinstance(expected, str) and bool(expected) and isinstance(supplied, str)
            and hmac.compare_digest(expected, supplied))
